From Health Connect: choose the type and RPE, then save.

Talos only reads from Health Connect and never writes to it. It reads resting heart rate, heart rate, heart rate variability (RMSSD), sleep, steps, weight and workouts.

Why: to fill your morning check-in (resting heart rate, HRV, bedtime and wake time), your weigh-in and today's training sessions, and to show today's steps on Today. When no resting heart rate is shared, Talos estimates it from your heart rate during the night and says so.

What stays on the phone: everything read from Health Connect stays on this phone until you tap Save on a check-in, a weigh-in or a training session. Only those saved numbers go to your club server, as if you had typed them. Steps are never uploaded.

You can change or withdraw access at any time in the Health Connect settings.
